gui.mca_vie.plan.withdraw_none: Every Sunday, after taxes are collected, %s %% of the treasury becomes available to players. Deposited emeralds stay with the village.
chat.mca_vie.talk.rain.open.0: What a downpour, %1$s… I'm soaked to the bone.
chat.mca_vie.talk.rain.open.1: Do you think this rain will ever stop?
chat.mca_vie.talk.rain.open.2: With this weather, the crops will rot in the field.
chat.mca_vie.talk.rain.yes.1: Let's get dry, I'll buy you a drink.
chat.mca_vie.talk.rain.end_yes.1: You're right, it'll be sunny tomorrow.
chat.mca_vie.talk.night.open.1: I don't like being out at night, with those zombies…
chat.mca_vie.talk.night.open.2: Look at those stars, beautiful, isn't it?
chat.mca_vie.talk.night.yes.0: You're right, I'll head home soon.
chat.mca_vie.talk.night.yes.1: The guards are watching, we're safe.
chat.mca_vie.talk.night.no.1: I do what I want at night.
chat.mca_vie.talk.night.end_yes.1: Be careful on your way home.
chat.mca_vie.talk.night.end_no.0: Fine, I'll leave you to your shadows.
chat.mca_vie.talk.sun.open.2: It's nice out today, makes you want to stroll.
chat.mca_vie.talk.sun.yes.0: Yes, let's enjoy it while it lasts!
chat.mca_vie.talk.sun.yes.1: Nothing better to cheer you up.
chat.mca_vie.talk.sun.no.0: Ugh, too hot for small talk.
chat.mca_vie.talk.sun.no.1: Some of us have work to do.
chat.mca_vie.talk.sun.end_yes.1: Meet you at the square tonight?
chat.mca_vie.talk.work.open.1: Being a %2$s isn't easy every day.
chat.mca_vie.talk.work.open.2: Got a lot done this morning, I like being a %2$s.
chat.mca_vie.talk.work.yes.0: You do good work, everyone says so.
chat.mca_vie.talk.work.no.1: If it's too hard, change jobs.
chat.mca_vie.talk.work.end_no.0: I'd like to see you try.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.open.0: %2$s in taxes… They're bleeding us dry, %1$s!
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.open.1: Did you see the taxes? %2$s, that's robbery.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.open.2: With these taxes I can't save a thing anymore.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.yes.1: Someone should talk to the village leader.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.no.0: Someone has to pay for walls and guards.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.no.1: Stop moaning, the village needs it.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.end_yes.0: If it goes on, I'm moving away.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.end_yes.1: At least we agree on that.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_high.end_no.0: You say that because you're well paid.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.open.0: Taxes are light at the moment, what a relief.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.open.1: We hardly pay anything, nice, eh %1$s?
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.open.2: The leader is generous with taxes lately.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.yes.0: Yes, I could buy new tools.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.no.0: And who'll keep the village running?
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.no.1: Don't celebrate too soon, it won't last.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.end_yes.0: Let's make the most of it.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.end_yes.1: I'll be able to spoil my family.
chat.mca_vie.talk.taxes_low.end_no.0: Always looking at the dark side…
chat.mca_vie.talk.birth.open.0: Did you hear? %2$s was just born!
chat.mca_vie.talk.birth.open.1: A new baby in the village: %2$s. Wonderful!
chat.mca_vie.talk.birth.open.2: They say little %2$s is doing well.
chat.mca_vie.talk.birth.yes.0: Yes, I saw the family, they're over the moon.
chat.mca_vie.talk.birth.yes.1: Good to see the village growing.
chat.mca_vie.talk.birth.end_yes.0: We should bring them a gift.
chat.mca_vie.talk.marriage.open.0: The wedding of %2$s, what a party!
chat.mca_vie.talk.marriage.open.2: I knew they'd end up together: %2$s.
chat.mca_vie.talk.death.open.0: I still think of %2$s… Rest in peace.
chat.mca_vie.talk.death.open.1: The village isn't the same without %2$s.
chat.mca_vie.talk.death.yes.1: Yes, the whole family was there. It was sad.
chat.mca_vie.talk.death.no.1: I didn't like them much, to be honest.
chat.mca_vie.talk.death.end_yes.1: Let's bring flowers to the grave someday.
chat.mca_vie.talk.justice.open.0: Did you hear? %2$s went before the court.
chat.mca_vie.talk.justice.yes.1: I hope it teaches them a lesson.
chat.mca_vie.talk.justice.no.0: I think they were wrongly accused.
chat.mca_vie.talk.justice.no.1: Mind your own business, it's better that way.
chat.mca_vie.talk.justice.end_yes.0: At least we can sleep soundly.
chat.mca_vie.talk.player.open.2: Do you know %2$s? People speak well of them.
chat.mca_vie.talk.player.yes.0: Yes, %2$s does a lot for the village.
chat.mca_vie.talk.player.yes.1: Always a kind word for everyone.
chat.mca_vie.talk.player.end_yes.1: We need more people like that.
chat.mca_vie.talk.family.open.2: I'm proud of you, you know.
chat.mca_vie.talk.family.yes.0: With pleasure, it always does me good.
chat.mca_vie.talk.family.no.0: Leave me alone for a bit.
chat.mca_vie.talk.friend.open.0: %1$s! Always a pleasure to see you.
chat.mca_vie.talk.friend.open.2: I missed you, we don't see each other enough!
chat.mca_vie.talk.friend.yes.0: Same here, let's chat a bit.
chat.mca_vie.talk.friend.no.0: Not now, I'm in a hurry.
chat.mca_vie.talk.friend.no.1: You never gave back what I lent you.
chat.mca_vie.talk.friend.end_no.1: Is that how you treat your friends?
chat.mca_vie.talk.gloomy.open.2: Sometimes I wonder why I stay here.
chat.mca_vie.talk.gloomy.yes.0: Chin up, it'll get better soon.
chat.mca_vie.talk.gloomy.yes.1: Come, I'll buy you a drink, take your mind off it.
chat.mca_vie.talk.gloomy.no.1: Stop moaning, you're not the only one.
chat.mca_vie.talk.rival.open.2: I've got my eye on you.
chat.mca_vie.talk.rival.yes.0: Calm down, I mean no harm.
chat.mca_vie.witness.theft.0: %s, a thief? I can't believe it.
chat.mca_vie.witness.theft.1: Serves %s right, they had to be stopped.
chat.mca_vie.witness.resurrection.0: What?! %s… is climbing out of the grave?!
chat.mca_vie.witness.resurrection.2: Help! %s came back from the dead!
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.shock.1: A ghost! It's the ghost of %s!
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.shock.2: Am I dreaming, or is that %s? I was at your funeral!
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.shock.3: Stay back, %s! You're supposed to be dead!
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.rumor.1: I'd heard %s came back, but seeing it…
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.rumor.2: %s again… I still can't get used to it.
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.family.0: %s! Is it really you? You came back to us!
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.family.1: I mourned you for so long, %s…
chat.mca_vie.resurrection.family.2: %s… Let me look at you. You haven't changed!

job.mca_vie.desc.farmer: Harvests ripe crops in their zone and replants with the seeds they carry.
job.mca_vie.desc.lumberjack: Fells natural trees in their zone, including other mods' trees, picks up saplings and replants. Never touches logs placed by players.
job.mca_vie.desc.fisher: Fishes from the bank in calm water in their zone.
job.mca_vie.desc.breeder: Shears sheep, breeds livestock and collects eggs in their zone.
job.mca_vie.desc.doctor: Treats sick or injured villagers in their zone. Produces nothing.
job.mca_vie.desc.blacksmith: Repairs villagers' damaged gear and items stored in their forge, using one iron ingot per repair.
job.mca_vie.desc.baker: Turns the wheat stored in their oven into bread: 3 wheat make 1 bread.
job.mca_vie.desc.teacher: Teaches the children and teens in their zone, which makes them happier. Produces nothing.
job.mca_vie.desc.guard: MCA guard: protects the village in melee.
job.mca_vie.desc.archer: MCA archer: protects the village with a bow.
job.mca_vie.desc.miner: Works a quarry: digs exposed stone and ores below the level of their cart, ores first. Never digs above it.
job.mca_vie.desc.cook: Cooks with what is stored in their pot: soups and stews (beetroot, mushroom, rabbit), then meat, fish and potatoes.
